about: Serve contact times in the four licensed bench clips (bench-data/clips), marked by eye on 2026-11-23 from contact sheets at 0.25 s and 0.1 s steps (W6.11). Each time is the frame where the racket meets the ball, good to about 0.15 s; the WebM seeks land within a frame or two. slow marks a serve played in slow motion; part marks one whose toss is hidden (a fade in from black). notServes are overheads and high swings that are not serves, kept so a scan that counts them can be caught. Tested by src/lib/analysis/__tests__/serveTimes.test.ts.

Saque_con_pelota.webm.note: One player on clay, side-on from behind the baseline, 320 by 240, four serves at normal speed.

0SAQUE.webm.note: A coaching video. To 25 s, front-on slow motion: a toss with no swing, then two serves. A title card from 25.2 to 30.2 s. Then the Saque_con_pelota serves at normal speed, 30.05 s later than in that clip.

notServes.what: a slow-motion toss, the arm held up, no swing
